temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl appears stressed and overwhelmed by the paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. When Maria offers help, Cheryl gratefully accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Before this moment, Maria did not have a specific belief that Cheryl was overwhelmed; she saw Cheryl as a capable colleague working on the outreach project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns that Cheryl is currently overwhelmed and openly receptive to assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl needs and welcomes help with the project, and Maria can meaningfully support her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and compassionate, with a readiness to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the community outreach project's paperwork and planning.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities with improved skill and growing confidence. At the staff meeting, Cheryl accepts the suggested leadership role and thanks Maria for her confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl had been overwhelmed but was capable and had accepted her help; she saw Cheryl as someone who might benefit from continued support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria's view shifts from Cheryl needing support to Cheryl being ready for greater responsibility.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, confident, and ready to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Proud, supportive, and confident in Cheryl.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl's leadership and help the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl tells Maria she was surprised by the leadership suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl was ready for leadership and had accepted the role, but she was worried Cheryl might feel pressured or think Maria had overstepped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns Cheryl did not feel pressured and instead valued Maria's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl appreciates Maria's support and there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially worried and anxious, then relieved and reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported and not pressured, and to preserve their trust and relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl responds enthusiastically to Maria's proposal to co-lead, saying it sounds fantastic, that Maria's guidance is invaluable, and that they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed Cheryl appreciated her support and that their relationship was secure; she was considering a closer collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns Cheryl welcomes co-leading and values Maria's guidance and partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They can effectively co-lead the project and support each other as a strong team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl says she would love to team up for more projects, that working with Maria has been wonderful, and that she is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believed their collaboration had been fruitful and their partnership had strengthened through successful projects; she was joyful about their synergy.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria's belief is confirmed and deepened as Cheryl shares enthusiasm for future collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is strong, mutual, and promising for future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue teaming up with Cheryl on future projects.
